study_identification_part.si4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objective to investigate the association between gray matter atrophy and normal connectome architecture at the individual level in depression. It also describes the purpose of using normative modeling to assess individualized regional atrophy.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we aimed to investigate the association between gray matter atrophy and normal connectome architecture at individual level in depression... For each patient, individualized regional atrophy was assessed using normative model... that could infer individual-level GMV differences by measuring its deviates from the healthy distribution

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study describes the eligibility criteria for the reference cohort (healthy controls) in both the discovery and replication datasets. It specifies that HCs were recruited from the community and screened for psychiatric/neurological history. Image quality standards (motion, SNR, IQR) and sample sizes (130 and 126) are reported.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The discovery dataset included... matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the community... None of them presented a history of serious medical or neuropsychiatric illness... Subjects were excluded if the translational and rotational displacement exceeded 3.0 mm or 3.0°... Four brain regions were excluded for low SNR

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study accounts for covariates by training the Gaussian process regression model on age and sex. Site effects are handled by using two independent datasets (Discovery and Replication) separately, effectively modeling each site with its own reference.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs... Two independent datasets were included in this study... All results reported in the main text were based on the discovery dataset and reproduced on the replication dataset.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: Methods/Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern; Methods/Participants

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data sources for the reference cohorts are described. Discovery HCs were recruited from the community (associated with First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University). Replication HCs were recruited from the community (associated with UESTC).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the community through poster advertisement... HCs (n = 126) were recruited from the community through poster advertisements

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: The imaging modality (T1-weighted MRI) and acquisition parameters (TR, TE, voxel size, scanner model) are fully specified for both datasets.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: The scanning parameters of T1weighted anatomical images were as follow: repetition time = 8164 ms, inversion time = 900 ms, echo time = 3.18 ms... voxel size = 1 x 1 x 1 mm 3... 3-Tsela GE Discovery MR750 scanner

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing software (SPM12, CAT12) and steps (segmentation, normalization, nonlinear modulation, smoothing) are described. Quality control procedures (IQR, head motion check) are also mentioned.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: GMV was measured with VBM analysis... using the recommended pipelines with the Computational Anatomy Toolbox (CAT12)... segmented... normalized... nonlinearly modulated and smoothed... The Image Quality Rating (IQR)... was recorded
nm5_data_preprocessing.location: Methods/Voxel based morphometry analysis; Methods/Data preprocessing

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study does not describe a data partitioning strategy (e.g., cross-validation) within the healthy reference cohort to validate the normative model itself. It states the model was trained on HCs and applied to patients without mentioning internal validation of the reference range.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: Methods/Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: While a replication dataset is used, the study implies that the procedures were repeated (i.e., a new model was trained on the replication HCs) rather than applying the discovery dataset's normative model to the replication HCs for validation.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: To assess the reproducibility of our results, the main procedures above were performed on an independent replication dataset.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical model (Gaussian process regression) and covariates (age, sex) are specified. However, the specific software or library used for the Gaussian process regression (e.g., PCNtoolkit, GPy) is not explicitly named in the text, although Marquand et al. (2016) is cited.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs... using normative model (Marquand et al., 2016)
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.location: Methods/Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: The study does not report quantitative performance metrics (e.g., explained variance, MAE) for the normative model fit on the healthy reference cohort. The reported R-squared values relate to the disease epicenter model, not the normative model itself.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: In general, the structural connectome architecture of the identified disease epicenters significantly explained 44%... variance of gray matter atrophy.

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: No data partitioning was described for the normative model, so this item is not applicable.

nm11_reproducibility.reason: The specific software version for the normative modeling (GPR) is not provided, and there is no statement regarding the availability of the code or trained models.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: Missing information on code availability and software versions for GPR.
